description: A Claude Code stepper picker (fictional wording, the shape of its autocompact offer): two digitless rows, the second drawing an adjustable value between ‹ › arrows, with ↑/↓ and ←/→ in the footer. Guards that the model reads it as a cursor list driven by Up/Down/Enter (←/→ are not its moves), with the highlight on the ‹ › row as `selected` (1). The picker digest that lets a walk drive that row is classify()'s and is proved in tests/test_cursor_select.py. Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-11-03).
